# CellValue

```csharp
public readonly struct CellValue
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

A value produced by a cell or a formula. `default` is [CellValue.Empty](SharpCell.CellValue.md#empty). Equality is identity (same kind, same payload, ordinal text), not Excel's `=`.

<a id="array-cellvalue"></a>
### Array(CellValue[,])

```csharp
public static CellValue Array(CellValue[,] values)
```

A rectangular array. The array is taken by reference and must not be mutated afterwards. Excel has no empty arrays, so both dimensions must be at least 1.

<a id="equals-cellvalue"></a>
### Equals(CellValue)


Whether both values have the same kind and content; arrays are compared element by element. This is not Excel's `=`, which ignores case.
